title: Pre-owned Louis Vuitton & a little rest: a Tokyo guide for Karina
intro: Hi Karina! You asked where to find pre-owned luxury bags in Tokyo. Since you are staying in Shinjuku, I start there. Then I add two more areas that are easy by train. I know you are mostly after Louis Vuitton, so I note which shops show it on their own sites. And because the moms may want a rest, there are a few good places to relax too.

areas.name: Shinjuku
areas.from_shinjuku: You are here. Everything below is a short walk.
areas.why: Your home base is also the easiest place to start. Several pre-owned shops sit within a few blocks of each other, and the rest options are close too.

photo.caption: A busy crossing on the east side of Shinjuku.
photo.author: Daniel L. Lu (dllu)

areas.plan: Half day: start at KOMEHYO around 11:00, walk to Brand Off and Daikokuya, then take a break at Re.Ra.Ku or Thermae-Yu before you decide what to buy.

places.name: KOMEHYO Shinjuku
places.text: A large Japanese pre-owned chain. Its official site lists Louis Vuitton as a main brand. The store has four floors (1F-4F).

places.name: KOMEHYO Shinjuku Women
places.text: The women's store next door, on B1F-4F. Good to check for handbags in the same visit.

places.name: BRAND OFF Shinjuku
places.text: Brand Off's Shinjuku shop sells in the store and lists order-in sales. The Brand Off online store shows Louis Vuitton bags.

places.name: Daikokuya Shinjuku Honten
places.text: The main Shinjuku store of Daikokuya, a Japanese brand-goods shop that sells and buys. Ask the staff what Louis Vuitton they have today.

places.name: Daikokuya Shinjuku Nibankan
places.text: A second Daikokuya store in Shinjuku 3-chome, near KOMEHYO.

places.name: Re.Ra.Ku Shinjuku
places.text: A relaxation salon with 30-minute body care courses. Good if you only have a short break between shops. It is 1 minute from Shinjuku-sanchome Station (exit C3).

places.name: Thermae-Yu Shinjuku
places.text: A hot-spring bathhouse in Kabukicho that is open 24 hours, with stone-bed saunas. Bathing is nude and separated by gender, so it suits those who like onsen. Plan 2 hours or more.

places.name: Mannenyu (Okubo)
places.text: A local sento (public bath) 5 minutes on foot from Shin-Okubo Station, the Korean town of Tokyo. Open 15:00-24:00 and closed on Saturdays. Pair it with a walk and snack in Shin-Okubo.

places.name: Joule Spa & Wellness, Hyatt Regency Tokyo
places.text: A hotel spa that is open to non-guests as a day spa, 11:00-20:00 daily. It has eight treatment rooms, including double rooms with city views. Book ahead.

areas.name: Harajuku and Omotesando
areas.from_shinjuku: About 5 minutes from Shinjuku on the JR Yamanote Line to Harajuku.
areas.why: A calm, tree-lined area where pre-owned luxury shops sit on the side streets near Cat Street.
areas.plan: Half day: arrive at 11:00, visit both shops, then walk down Omotesando for a late lunch and go back by train.

places.name: RAGTAG Harajuku
places.text: A pre-owned designer store on two floors. The official floor guide lists Louis Vuitton, Chanel and Hermes on the women's floor.

places.name: KOMEHYO VINTAGE TOKYO
places.text: KOMEHYO's vintage-focused store in Jingumae, on the basement and ground floors. Ask staff about vintage bags.

areas.name: Ginza
areas.from_shinjuku: About 15 minutes from Shinjuku-sanchome on the Marunouchi Line to Ginza.
areas.why: Japan's classic shopping district. Three pre-owned shops are on or near the main streets, so it is easy to compare.

photo.caption: Chuo-dori, the main street of Ginza.
photo.author: Soramimi

areas.plan: Half day: start at KOMEHYO Ginza at 11:00, walk up Chuo-dori to Daikokuya and Brand Off, then stop for tea.

places.name: KOMEHYO Ginza
places.text: The Ginza branch of KOMEHYO, on floors 1, 2 and 4. Its official site lists Louis Vuitton as a main brand.

places.name: Daikokuya Ginza
places.text: Daikokuya's Ginza store. It sells and buys brand goods. Ask staff about Louis Vuitton in stock.

places.name: BRAND OFF Ginza Honten
places.text: Brand Off's main Ginza store on floors 1-4, with in-store and order-in sales. The Brand Off online store shows Louis Vuitton bags.

lv: Date codes: Louis Vuitton bags carry a date code or serial stamp, and where it sits changes by year and by model. Ask the staff to show you where it is on the bag you like.
Ask for the shop's authenticity guarantee in writing, or ask how the shop checks its items.
Look closely at the corners, the handles and the zipper. These wear first, and shops grade condition from there.
general: Tax-free shopping: bring your physical passport. Shops need to see it at the time of purchase.
Authenticity: each store has its own policy on guarantees and certificates. Ask before you pay.
Condition grades: shops grade each item. The scale differs by shop, so ask staff to explain it if you are unsure.
Many shops open around 11:00. Check the store's page on the day, as hours can change.

notes: Dropped: Nakano Broadway, Daikanyama/Ebisu, Vintage Qoo, Amore, Raffine, Shin-Okubo Korean body-scrub spas, Thai massage: no official page confirmed. Map coordinates are approximate (building level); the Google Maps links are the reference.
